job.text: Did motor-vehicle deaths plummet in the 2000s?

insight.important: Deaths declined after the 1970s, but gently, not in a plunge

title.text: Motor-Vehicle Deaths Declined Gently After the 1970s

source.shows: decades followed by half-decades: unequal bins, which fake a plunge (R2-43, G2.41 [L]); the deaths add up, so the half-decades are re-aggregated to decades, 2000–2009 and 2010–2019 (02 §5.4 (f)), and the true pattern shows
the same bins without saying the values add up: re-aggregating would guess, so refused (R2-43, D-1)

overrides.reason: the book's bad version, rebuilt for comparison

job.text: Look up the deaths in each period

source.shows: the book's bad version, the unequal bins drawn through an override: the plunge in the 2000s is the half-decades' doing
